params.body:
## Why

Reported by the dealer team on 2026-09-16 (dealer "Legends by Legal Broker"): under Instellingen > Website a dealer picks a theme (light/dark), a font, an accent colour and the colour of the "wagenaanbod" toggle, saves, and the iframe on his site does not change. Since the August rebuild the embed had a fixed Stocklist look: `index.blade.php` said so in a comment, the theme partials targeted the old markup (`.nav-link`, `.vehicle`, `.rounded-pill`) the new views no longer have, the detail page did not include them at all, and both stylesheets forced Inter with `!important`. Decision (owner): the dealer's choices apply again; the app as used is correct.

## What changed

- `public/css/website-iframe.css` and `public/css/website-detail.css` are token based: `--w-bg`, `--w-fg`, `--w-muted`, `--w-faint`, `--w-surface`, `--w-panel`, `--w-field`, `--w-line`, `--w-line-soft`, `--w-field-line`, `--w-accent`, `--w-accent-fg`, `--w-button`, `--w-button-fg`, `--w-font`, with the current Stocklist look as defaults. Layout untouched; colours and font only. Neither file knows a dealer colour any more.
- `website/theme/base.blade.php` is one small `<style>` that writes the dealer's values into those variables, plus the Google font `<link>` (only when a font is set and it is not the stored default Roboto). `light.blade.php` and `dark.blade.php` set the neutral tokens (page, ink, muted, surface, lines, `color-scheme`). All dead selectors removed (1.000 lines).
- `detail.blade.php` includes the same partials; its Tailwind colour utilities (`bg-white`, `text-brand-*`, `border-brand-*`) moved to `w-card`, `w-btn--primary|ghost`, `w-ink`, `w-muted`, `w-faint`, `w-line-soft`, `w-hr`, `w-note`, bound to the tokens. The contact and Car-Pass modals, the lightbox and the "Foto volgt" placeholder follow the theme. `WebsiteController::detail` passes `website_toggle_button_color` like `index` does, so both pages carry the same variables.
- `App\Support\Colour` (`normalise`, `contrastText`, `luminance`): white or ink on the accent and the button from WCAG relative luminance (threshold 0.45), chosen in PHP, not CSS. The pre-August partial read the hex from offset 1 as if a `#` were stored, so it judged the wrong digits.
- Rule R S2-5.19 in `12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`; finding `2026-09-16-iframe-thema-en-kleuren-genegeerd.md` (opgelost); the misleading comment in `index.blade.php` replaced.

## What each setting colours

| Setting | Variable | Paints |
|---|---|---|
| `website_theme` | neutral tokens | light: paper; dark: night ground, light ink, darker surfaces for cards, filter panel, modals |
| `website_font` | `--w-font` | every text in the embed (Google font loaded with `display=swap`); Roboto or empty = Inter, no request to Google |
| `website_headcolor` | `--w-accent` | links, active filter pill, filter chips, slider fill and thumbs, histogram bars, focus rings, checkboxes, the "Stel een vraag" button and the submit button in the contact modal, thumbnail selection, option bullets. Default `#249DE0` (R S2-6.3) |
| `website_toggle_button_color` | `--w-button` | only the "Toon online voorraad" / "toon enkel eigen wagens" toggle (`stocklist_integration.blade.php`), filled for "on", outlined for "off"; exactly what `.rounded-pill` received before August. Without a choice it follows the accent |

## Tests

`WebsiteThemeTest` (list and detail for a dealer with dark / 565455 / 968453 / Montserrat, defaults and no font link for a dealer without settings, Roboto loads nothing, light accent gets ink, the stylesheets read the tokens and define none as itself), `ColourTest`. Ran with `WebsiteIframeHeightTest`, `WebsiteWarrantyCalculatorTest`, `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`: 41 tests, 926 assertions, green; `SmokeTest` website routes: 13/13.

## Visual check

Demo dataset, embed list and detail at 1200 wide with dark / 565455 / 968453 / Montserrat and with the light defaults: dark ground everywhere incl. the contact modal, Montserrat loaded (`document.fonts`), toggle in the button colour, accent on links and active filters.
params.title: Website embed: the dealer's theme, font and colours apply again
